questions.prompt: Which part of the cell controls its activities?
questions.explanation: The nucleus contains DNA, which controls the cell.

questions.prompt: Select **all** structures found in plant cells but **not** in animal cells.
questions.explanation: Remember the 3 Cs: cell wall, chloroplasts and a large central vacuole.

questions.prompt: Which organelle releases energy by respiration?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are the site of aerobic respiration.

questions.prompt: Which is the correct order, smallest to largest?
questions.explanation: Cells form tissues, tissues form organs, organs form systems.

questions.prompt: Red blood cells have no nucleus, giving more space for haemoglobin.
questions.explanation: This adaptation helps them carry more oxygen.

questions.prompt: Describe how you would prepare a slide of onion cells to view under a microscope.
questions.marking_guide: 1 mark: peel a thin epidermis layer. 1 mark: place on slide with a drop of iodine/water. 1 mark: lower cover slip at an angle to avoid air bubbles (or: view at low power first).
questions.explanation: Thin layer → stain with iodine → cover slip at an angle → low power first.
